stem.text: The graph shows the results of investigations into the effect of amylase on the hydrolysis of starch at three different temperatures.

stem.alt: Graph of concentration of reducing sugar in arbitrary units against time in minutes, with three curves labelled 50 °C, 60 °C and 70 °C.

stem.text: In each investigation the concentration and volume of the solutions was kept constant.

A.text: $50\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ is the optimum temperature of amylase.

B.text: At $60\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ all the starch is hydrolysed after 30 minutes.

C.text: At $70\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ the amylase is denatured before hydrolysis is complete.

D.text: The rate of hydrolysis of starch is faster at $50\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ than at $70\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$.
